sprint11-read-baseline-compact.json.limitations: Synthetic bulk fixtures; actual runtime login, tenant gates and pool 10. Fresh application per case; fixture insertion warms PostgreSQL/OS caches. SQL plans and pure policy compilation are separate post-load probes to avoid timing interference. Browser measured separately. No serving database writes.
